<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918408_theRebbe_266" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918408_theRebbe_266__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the header information for the maamar, including the Torah portion and date.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Emor,</t>
    <t s="2">the 13th of Iyar,</t>
    <t s="3">the year 5725 (1965).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that "I will be sanctified" involves an arousal from below upward, followed by two types of drawing down from above through Torah and mitzvos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"And I will be sanctified amidst the children of Israel; I am the L-rd who sanctifies you."</t>
    <t s="1">And the Alter Rebbe explains in Likkutei Torah, the discourse beginning with the word "Zeh,"</t>
    <t s="2">that "And I will be sanctified amidst the children of Israel"</t>
    <t s="3">(the revelation of His holiness within the heart</t>
    <t s="4">of Israel)</t>
    <t s="5">is in a manner of from below to above,</t>
    <t s="6">that the heart of Israel burns like fiery flames to be included in His holiness,</t>
    <t s="7">and through this, afterward is drawn "I am the L-rd who sanctifies you,"</t>
    <t s="8">the drawing down of His holiness from above to below.</t>
    <t s="9">And in this itself</t>
    <t s="10">(in the drawing down from above to below)</t>
    <t s="11">there are two matters,</t>
    <t s="12">the drawing down through Torah and the drawing down through mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="13">For the drawing down that is through Torah is in the inwardness of the worlds</t>
    <t s="14">(in spirituality),</t>
    <t s="15">and in order for the drawing down to be in the externality of the worlds</t>
    <t s="16">(in physicality),</t>
    <t s="17">it is through the performance of mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is the meaning of what is said, "Holy, holy, holy,"</t>
    <t s="19">that the first "holy" is an elevation from below to above,</t>
    <t s="20">and the second and third "holy" are drawings down from above to below,</t>
    <t s="21">through Torah and through mitzvos.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the three "holies" correspond to three levels of Kesser, and the difference in their mode of revelation stems from their distinct levels.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">And he continues in</t>
    <t s="2">(the explanation of)</t>
    <t s="3">the maamar,</t>
    <t s="4">that the three times "holy" are three levels.</t>
    <t s="5">The first "holy" is Kesser</t>
    <t s="6">(which is above Chochmah),</t>
    <t s="7">the second "holy" is the Kesser of Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="8">and the third "holy" is the Kesser of Malchus.</t>
    <t s="9">And one can explain this based on what is known,</t>
    <t s="10">that "holy"</t>
    <t s="11">(in general)</t>
    <t s="12">refers to the Surrounding Light, which is holy and separate from the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="13">Therefore, the primary concept of "holy"</t>
    <t s="14">(the first "holy")</t>
    <t s="15">is in Kesser, which is above Chochmah</t>
    <t s="16">(for Chochmah is the beginning of the chain of descent).</t>
    <t s="17">And that which even the Kesser of Zeir Anpin and the Kesser of Malchus are called by the name "holy,"</t>
    <t s="18">is</t>
    <t s="19">because the descent of the Kessarim is not like the descent of cause and effect, where the effect is a different entity from the cause,</t>
    <t s="20">but rather,</t>
    <t s="21">all the Kessarim are one essence,</t>
    <t s="22">and even after the descent of the Kesser to become the Kesser of Zeir Anpin or of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="23">it is in its essence as it was before</t>
    <t s="24">(the Kesser that is above Chochmah).</t>
    <t s="25">And one could say,</t>
    <t s="26">that this which is explained in the maamar, that the three times "holy" are distinct in their level</t>
    <t s="27">(that the first "holy" is the Kesser above Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="28">and the second and third "holy" are the Kesser of Zeir Anpin and of Malchus),</t>
    <t s="29">is also an explanation of the difference in their manner</t>
    <t s="30">(that the first "holy" is in a manner of from below to above, and the second and third "holy" are in a manner of from above to below).</t>
    <t s="31">For the Surrounding [Light]</t>
    <t s="32">(Kesser)</t>
    <t s="33">itself,</t>
    <t s="34">since it is completely holy and separate,</t>
    <t s="35">its revelation in a person is in a manner that he recognizes and feels that this is a matter that is wondrous and separate from him,</t>
    <t s="36">and therefore he yearns to go out of his existence and be included in that wondrous matter,</t>
    <t s="37">and when the Surrounding [Light] descends to become the Kesser of Zeir Anpin or of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="38">then its revelation is in a manner that it is drawn downward.</t>
    <t s="39">And likewise, regarding the second and third "holy,"</t>
    <t s="40">the difference in the manner of their drawing down is because they are distinct in their level.</t>
    <t s="41">For the second "holy,"</t>
    <t s="42">since its descent is that it becomes the Kesser of Zeir Anpin</t>
    <t s="43">(for Zeir Anpin is the end of Atzilus),</t>
    <t s="44">its drawing down is</t>
    <t s="45">(only)</t>
    <t s="46">in the inwardness of the worlds</t>
    <t s="47">(through Torah),</t>
    <t s="48">and the third "holy,"</t>
    <t s="49">which descends to become the Kesser of Malchus</t>
    <t s="50">(for Malchus is the root of the created beings),</t>
    <t s="51">its drawing down is</t>
    <t s="52">(also)</t>
    <t s="53">in the externality of the worlds</t>
    <t s="54">(through the performance of mitzvos).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
